name: Verdant Sigil
summary: In Shadowglen, Conservator Ilthalaine sends young night elf druids toward the start of their training with the Verdant Sigil.

sections.title: A Summons to the Path
sections.body: Young night elves in Shadowglen receive the Verdant Sigil when they feel the call of the wild. Conservator Ilthalaine gives it to them with a message from Mardant Strongoak, their druid trainer. It directs the novices to climb into Aldrassil's boughs and begin their serious study. There they leave basic chores behind to learn communion with nature spirits and the mysteries of the Emerald Dream.

sections.title: The First Step Into the Dream
sections.body: Presenting the Verdant Sigil to Mardant Strongoak begins a young druid's lifelong craft. Novices cannot yet walk the sleeping trance of the Emerald Dream, but the token marks the start of their mentorship. Under Mardant's instruction, they learn to read the wilderness's whispers. They also practice early shapeshifting and healing arts in service of Teldrassil.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Verdant Sigil?
aliases: why do i have verdant sigil
faq.answer: The Verdant Sigil summons novice night elf druids in Shadowglen to find Mardant Strongoak in Aldrassil and begin formal training.

faq.q: Who hands out the Verdant Sigil?
aliases: where do i get verdant sigil
faq.answer: Conservator Ilthalaine gives the Verdant Sigil to budding druids in Shadowglen with a message from Mardant Strongoak.

faq.q: Where do I take the sigil once I receive it?
aliases: where do i bring verdant sigil
faq.answer: You bring the Verdant Sigil to Mardant Strongoak, the druid trainer in Aldrassil's central chambers at the heart of Shadowglen.

faq.q: What happens after presenting the sigil to Mardant Strongoak?
aliases: what does mardant do with sigil
faq.answer: Mardant accepts the Verdant Sigil and welcomes you as his student. He teaches you communion with nature and prepares you for the mysteries of the Emerald Dream as your strength grows.

angles.text: As a young night elf druid, the Verdant Sigil marks your first rite of passage from basic forest tending to disciplined Cenarion teaching.
Beneath Aldrassil's canopy, the sigil reflects the kaldorei tradition of attuning your spirit to the natural world and Teldrassil's guardians.
